title: Approve <decision>
description:
Problem/Goal: <decision> needs a recorded human decision before dependent work starts.
Key actions: none for an agent; approvers review the subject revision and decide with `macc coordinator approve|reject|request-changes`.
Out of scope: any implementation; the subject task produces the proposal.
Success criteria: the quorum is recorded for the current subject revision.
objective: Obtain the required human approval of <subject>.
result: An approval bound to the subject's commit, with evidence, recorded in the coordinator ledger.

risks: <what goes wrong if this is approved in error>

acceptance_criteria: The required approvers recorded an approval of the current subject revision.
